title: Sam K
content: In 2017, when I was 33, I was on my last service call for a plumbing company. I arrived at a commercial building for a hot water heater call. When I got there, I found it was an electrical hot water heater running on 480 volts. It was powered by what I believe were solar panels in the parking lot. To make a long story short, I asked where the panel for the power shut-off was. A gentleman named Marco said he had shut off the panels himself before I arrived. I double-checked the unit to confirm the power was off and noticed the heater was not running. I continued to work and was reaching down to get the booklet stored inside the unit, when I heard a loud pop. My entire body flinched and contracted. Within less than a split second, I felt a release and experienced an expansion out into a tunnel of lightning. The tunnel was moving at vortex-like speed through a spaceless state of oneness. It was like being a droplet in an experience beyond words, and all happening at once. I communicated with a few light beings. I witnessed other angelic and alien experiences from the other side. I saw myself being wheeled out to an ambulance and then loaded into a helicopter as it took off. I went back to the other side. Then I was brought back into my body that was inside the helicopter. I came back with a message that I was not done yet and it was not my time. Since then, life has been interesting. I can say it is a double-edged sword coming back from the little taste of the other side. I no longer do plumbing and am now into mediumship and healing. Mostly channeling and trance speaking are my passions now. I feel sure this change is part of my soul path because the NDE helped me connect for the bigger reasons behind what happened, from the past to now, if that makes sense.

elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, I feel like I am always in an altered state of consciousness most of the day now, but I am still learning how to use it correctly.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I have always done things a certain way since birth, but coming to the US I got sidetracked. The more I think about it, all things happen for a reason. During that time, my life was going in the wrong direction.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, If I can recall, I was unconscious for more than 10 minutes. The time when the ambulance was called could have been about 15 minutes or so. When I was in the light, it felt like graduating from a semester, getting a download there, and then coming back.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I had a few preconceptions and now understand what telepathy is really about.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: Clairaudience is a bit overwhelming at times.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, but the facts have not been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes, Each soul is a droplet of light, and that droplet goes into a tunnel of endless space for us to be in. A void of emptiness but filled with a light soup with no human expression, while experiencing a feeling of the love-sounding field where we all bathe in. But yet, it is more than that.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes, Light beings like a transparent, plasmic force, not like a human form with limbs, but just light beings or orbs communicating through telepathy.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm, A water-like liquid substance and an airy-like space was where I was.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe, The entanglements of all coexisting, from atoms to the cosmos, all work together if you know how.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from my personal future, It's all possible potential, but there are cycles that occur that we can notice in times.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will, They said I'm not finished.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Buddhist, I returned to Buddhism, but after some time I moved on to a higher calling.
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes, I don't believe in religion, but I would put myself more in the spiritual category.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I feel belief does take a big part in encountering the specific experience during the NDE. But along with that, it depends on how open the person is beyond their belief system in their life.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, Other than the light beings, I remember a cloud-like intelligence that showed me things. For instance, I was in was the cloud, like a room. Throughout the room, portals were open and showed me what happened.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, Encounter with an ascending master.
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes, They showed me the reasoning why it all happened.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, Souls come and go to balance the Earth. Yes, but I'm still learning so I'm not 100% certain. Everything I say is based on my own personal experience.
Yes, Love is what we are made of from birth and even before we come into physical form.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes, Yes, I'm more of a hermit now. Human relationships are a bit difficult for me at times.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, I can express it better now due to my life experience, where I can connect the dots from that NDE and understand the reasoning in my own explanation and communication.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, I can say it was a perfect storm at the time of my life. I needed exactly what happened for me to get to the place I am heading to now, from where I started as a human being.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The entire experience was significantly meaningful. All of it!
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes, When I was little, before coming to the US, I remembered asking my mom why people die. Years before coming to America, during a mushroom trip, I went through a white tunnel exactly the same way I went through during my electrocution.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, If I would have denied my experience, I would have been in a psychiatric home.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, To shake me up to get back on track from how I was living.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I feel that the electrocution made me more sensitive, and it gets overwhelming at times in my senses because it's all energy. In my opinion.
elements.Did the questions asked and information: Yes, In all, the explanation was from me remembering during that time. In that experience, I know I went somewhere, simultaneously overseeing the happenings here in real time and going back and forth. In between, I experienced beings in different time and space during my NDE.
